jobs.subject: Rannoch — base du signal, passerelle extérieure face au canyon
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one opaque landscape 16:9 master background for a Mass Effect 2D fighting-stage prototype, with the detailed real-time 3D game visual language of Mass Effect 3.
Primary request: depict the exterior passage of the Rannoch geth base overlooking the sunset canyon, matching the attached original production screenshot as closely as possible.
Input image 1 is the structural, composition, material and lighting authority. Preserve the two massive inward-slanting structural supports at left and right, the metal overhead truss and parallel projecting rails, the low faceted dark geth barriers with small cyan lights, the left sandstone spire, the layered canyon horizon, the two slender rock formations at right, and the dusty orange sunset behind the upper-right structure. Keep these specific shapes and positions, not generic science-fiction architecture.
Composition: a wide, stable straight-on camera at the same height and direction as the reference. Adapt its extra-wide aspect to 16:9 primarily by revealing more of the existing metal floor below. The lower quarter must read as a continuous empty horizontal fighting lane, using the same bronze-gray metal floor panels and worn seams. Keep the cable coil behind this lane, not across fighter feet. Retain the depth toward the canyon, side framing and overhead structure. Do not add a detached platform or a new building.
Lighting: preserve the warm grazing sunlight, shadowed steel framing and restrained cyan practical lights; avoid an exaggerated lens flare over the playable lane. High-detail game-environment rendering, crisp readable silhouette, realistic materials, not painterly.
Constraints: one complete environment only. No people, aliens, robots, weapons, HUD, captions, game title, logos, borders, collage, or in-image labels. No extra planets, moons, ships or Reaper. Opaque full-frame image.

jobs.subject: Despoina — épave de surface sous la pluie
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one opaque landscape 16:9 master background for a Mass Effect 2D fighting-stage prototype, detailed real-time 3D game rendering.
Primary request: depict the surface shipwreck on 2181 Despoina from Mass Effect 3: Leviathan with very close reference fidelity.
Input image 1 is the primary composition and landmark authority: the towering dark T-shaped broken ship superstructure just left of center, the long damaged horizontal crossbeam and dangling cables, a smaller distant T-shaped wreck at left, rough gray ocean on the far left, and sloping wreck panels with improvised tarpaulins on the right. Preserve the rain, cold blue-gray storm sky, skeletal mast geometry, floodlights, small antennas and corroded wet surfaces. Input image 2 is only a close material/detail reference for the existing tarps, metal plates, ropes and wreck geometry; do not switch to its camera angle and do not add its shuttle.
Composition: keep the recognizable primary reference viewpoint and landmarks. Reveal a little more of the connected near deck as a continuous horizontal walkway across the lower quarter, made from the same damaged ship metal. The central fighting lane must be clear and visually level; keep collapsed panels, tarps and crates behind it or at the edges. This is still the irregular stranded wreck at the ocean surface, not a separate pristine arena and not an underwater scene.
Lighting: dim storm daylight with rain streaks, damp reflections, steel-blue atmospheric recession, limited existing white work lights. No fire, volcanic terrain or bright neon lighting.
Constraints: exactly one complete wide scene. No characters, enemies, giant creature, HUD, text labels, game logo, black footer, watermark, decorative border or collage. Preserve the location-specific wreck silhouette, not a generic naval ship or a new sci-fi city. Opaque full-frame image.

jobs.subject: Havarl — seuil de structure reliquat ouvert sur la jungle
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one opaque landscape 16:9 master background for a Mass Effect 2D fighting-stage prototype, with the realistic detailed environment rendering of Mass Effect: Andromeda.
Primary request: closely reconstruct the attached Havarl production frame, the view outward from a ruined Remnant threshold into the wet alien jungle. This exact frame is the structural, atmosphere and vegetation authority.
Preserve the huge dark angular Remnant jamb at left leaning toward the center with fine cyan circuit inlays, the irregular horizontal stone-metal lintel overhead, the shadowed vertical mass at right, and the tall vegetation-fringed rectangular ruin beyond the opening. Preserve the cloudy blue night sky, dense hanging vines, wet dark ground, broad purple leaves, low cyan-blue luminous plants and the deep jungle depth. Do not turn the Remnant structure into a human metal doorway.
Composition: maintain the original doorway framing and view direction. Extend the connected foreground threshold horizontally along the lower quarter for an empty level fighting lane, with subtle same-material seams and damp patches. Preserve the thick frame at the left and right edges; move only small rocks or ground vegetation out of the clear central lane. Keep the uneven forest trail and small stone ledges beyond the lane.
Lighting: source-like dark indigo jungle with cool soft illumination from the opening and restrained cyan plant/circuit glow. Lift foreground shadow detail just enough for fighter-foot readability without changing this into daytime. Fine environment detail, not cartoon or painterly.
Constraints: exactly one scene. No Tempest ship, new buildings, people, monsters, weapons, HUD, title, game logo, explanatory labels, borders or collage. No generic fantasy ruins, runic door, crystals or orange torches. Opaque full-frame image.

jobs.subject: Citadelle — Silversun Strip, promenade devant Armax et Tiberius Towers
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one opaque landscape 16:9 master background for a Mass Effect 2D fighting-stage prototype, in the detailed real-time 3D visual language of Mass Effect 3.
Primary request: reproduce the specific Silversun Strip promenade from the Citadel DLC, using the two attached gameplay screenshots as geometry and lighting references.
Image 1 is the primary wide architectural composition: recessed lower-level entrances, the bright continuous balcony above them, pink holographic tree near the middle, yellow-gold signage on the left and cyan-green signage at right, distant layered pink neon ribbons and blue vertical casino signage, large overhead facade panels outlined in gold at left and green at right. Image 2 shows the SAME promenade from a nearby angle and is the floor, rail, entrance and planter reference. Do not copy the annotations or characters from either screenshot.
Keep the entrance layout and proportions: ARMAX ARENA left, SILVERSUN STRIP information kiosk near center-right, TIBERIUS TOWERS to the right, dark tiled floor with metal seams, low planters with pale casing and blue light accents, gold handrails leading toward the lower walkway, narrow upper-level balcony. Preserve the rich pink/cyan/gold lighting without making a new generic cyberpunk street.
Composition: a straight, wide view toward those entrances at roughly the first reference camera height. The lower quarter is the existing dark tiled promenade, cleared for two fighters; move the nearest sofa and only the obstructing foreground planter out of the central lane, keeping their visual language at the side edges. Keep the depth change, stairs and railings behind the usable near lane. No open void across the foreground.
Text: retain only the environmental signs visible in the architecture, with exact spelling where readable: “ARMAX ARENA”, “SILVERSUN STRIP”, “TIBERIUS TOWERS”. Do not invent new signs or copy any Russian quest text, numbers 31/32/33, purchase notification or other HUD.
Constraints: one continuous empty environment. No Shepard, pedestrians, alien civilians, human-shaped hologram, weapons, HUD, caption, game logo, watermark, border or collage. Opaque full-frame image.

jobs.subject: Silversun Strip — correction du texte vertical CASTLE / ARCADE
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a surgical lettering-only correction of input image 1, the already finished Silversun Strip stage master. Input image 2 is the original game screenshot, used ONLY to verify the vertical sign lettering. The establishment is CASTLE ARCADE.
Edit target: the existing large blue vertical neon sign with the narrow pink outline in the upper-right background, behind the balcony, and the visible smaller repetition of this same sign just to its left. Change ONLY the incorrect letters inside these existing signs. Keep their exact panel geometry, perspective, position, scale, neon color, glow and borders.
The sign contains two vertical columns, six letters in each. Left column, top to bottom: C A S T L E. Right column, top to bottom: A R C A D E.
The exact six horizontal letter pairs from top to bottom must therefore be:
C  A
A  R
S  C
T  A
L  D
E  E
Render each letter clearly in the existing condensed white-blue neon capitals. Maintain the existing close spacing, perspective and depth; the smaller repeated version must show the same correct words at its existing smaller size. Do not write CASCADE, CASINO or any invented word.
Absolutely preserve EVERYTHING ELSE from input 1: all architecture, geometry, framing, camera, balcony, floor tiles, empty fighting lane, stairs, handrails, planter positions, holographic trees, neon ribbons, facade panels, lighting, reflections, texture, image size and composition. Keep the three already-correct horizontal signs EXACTLY unchanged: ARMAX ARENA, SILVERSUN STRIP, TIBERIUS TOWERS. Do not redraw the architecture or add/remove objects. Do not change any foreground text or layout. Do not import people, UI or notification text from input 2.
Output one complete opaque image, the same 1672 × 941 wide composition as input 1, with only the requested vertical lettering corrected.
